W.note: Neat collapsed bar, but opened it has dead space at the bottom, an odd carrier-tab row, no keyboard-state announcement, and the mobile layout sits off-center.

X.note: Richest tracking with check timeline, NOW marker, locations, ETA window, copy and notify switch, but opened it is tall and the action chips wrap awkwardly.

Y.note: Tight pill expands to a dense timeline with ETA, carrier, copy, carrier link and a segmented progress bar, with live region and full labeling.

Z.note: Compact green-accented toast with stepper, short scan list and actions plus multi-package dots, though the subtitle truncates and the dot pager is tiny.
